test_binary_flat_index: test IndexBinaryFlat by adding vectors and searching for nearest neighbors with Hamming distance
test_binary_ivf_index: test IndexBinaryIVF by training on data, adding vectors, and searching with configurable nprobe
test_binary_hnsw_index: test IndexBinaryHNSW by building an HNSW graph and searching for approximate nearest neighbors
test_binary_replicas_and_shards: test IndexBinaryReplicas and IndexBinaryShards for distributed search across multiple sub-indices
test_binary_pq_encoding: test ProductQuantizer that mimics a binary encoder by computing codes and verifying round-trip accuracy
